title: MetricValue_for_uint64
description: A single telemetry number, tagged with why it might not be a plain value. Used for both genuine rates (CPU%, network throughput) and point-in-time gauges (memory used, disk free) — gauges simply never produce the `SampleGap`/`CounterReset` variants. Deliberately separate from `SelfMetricValue<T>` (U0's service self-monitoring type); unifying the two is a candidate for a later cleanup unit, not this one.

oneOf.description: Elapsed time between samples exceeded 2x the configured sample interval — a rate computed across that gap would be misleading.
The underlying counter decreased between samples (NIC reinit, process restart, etc.) — never reported as a negative rate.
